using Dates
using Printf
struct CommandError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(CommandError(s))
check(b, s) = b ? nothing : fail(s)
signedtext(x) = x>=0 ? "+$x" : string(x)
namelist(xs) = join(sort!(collect(xs)), ' ')
function decimals(n, d)
    cents=div(100n, d)
    @sprintf("%d.%02d", div(cents, 100), cents%100)
end
function parsedate(text)
    try
        Date(parse(Int, text[1:4]), parse(Int, text[6:7]), parse(Int, text[9:10]))
    catch e
        e isa ArgumentError || rethrow()
        fail("invalid date $text")
    end
end
datetext(d) =
    Dates.format(d, dateformat"yyyy-mm-dd")*" "*["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"][dayofweek(
        d,
    )]
mutable struct WorkTask
    base::Int
    resource::String
    units::Int
    notbefore::Int
    crashlimit::Union{Nothing,Int}
    crashcost::Int
    crashed::Int
    estimate::Union{Nothing,Tuple{Int,Int,Int}}
end
WorkTask(d, r, u) = WorkTask(d, r, u, 0, nothing, 0, 0, nothing)
duration(t) = t.base-t.crashed
struct Dependency
    a::String
    b::String
    kind::String
    lag::Int
end
struct Schedule
    d::Dict{String,Int}
    es::Dict{String,Int}
    ef::Dict{String,Int}
    ls::Dict{String,Int}
    lf::Dict{String,Int}
    tf::Dict{String,Int}
    ff::Dict{String,Int}
    length::Int
end
mutable struct Project
    tasks::Dict{String,WorkTask}
    links::Dict{Tuple{String,String},Dependency}
    start::Union{Nothing,Date}
    holidays::Set{Date}
    deadline::Union{Nothing,Date}
    capacities::Dict{String,Int}
    baseline::Union{Nothing,Schedule}
end
Project() = Project(
    Dict{String,WorkTask}(),
    Dict{Tuple{String,String},Dependency}(),
    nothing,
    Set{Date}(),
    nothing,
    Dict{String,Int}(),
    nothing,
)
function gettask(p, name)
    check(haskey(p.tasks, name), "unknown task $name")
    p.tasks[name]
end
tasknames(p) = sort!(collect(keys(p.tasks)))
preds(p, name) = sort!([dep for dep in values(p.links) if dep.b==name]; by = x->x.a)
succs(p, name) = sort!([dep for dep in values(p.links) if dep.a==name]; by = x->x.b)
function topo(p)
    pending=Set(tasknames(p))
    order=String[]
    while !isempty(pending)
        ready=[
            name for
            name in sort!(collect(pending)) if all(dep->!(dep.a in pending), preds(p, name))
        ]
        isempty(ready) && break
        name=first(ready)
        delete!(pending, name)
        push!(order, name)
    end
    order
end
function cyclenotation(p, order)
    remaining=setdiff(Set(tasknames(p)), Set(order))
    walk=[minimum(remaining)]
    while true
        previous=first([dep.a for dep in preds(p, last(walk)) if dep.a in remaining])
        at=findfirst(==(previous), walk)
        if at!==nothing
            cycle=[previous; reverse(walk[(at+1):end])]
            firstat=argmin(cycle)
            cycle=[cycle[firstat:end]; cycle[1:(firstat-1)]]
            return join([cycle; first(cycle)], " -> ")
        end
        push!(walk, previous)
    end
end
function analysisorder(p)
    check(!isempty(p.tasks), "no tasks")
    order=topo(p)
    check(
        length(order)==length(p.tasks),
        "cycle "*(length(order)<length(p.tasks) ? cyclenotation(p, order) : ""),
    )
    order
end
startbound(dep, starts, finishes, d) =
    dep.kind=="FS" ? finishes[dep.a]+dep.lag :
    dep.kind=="SS" ? starts[dep.a]+dep.lag : finishes[dep.a]+dep.lag-d
finishbound(dep, starts, finishes, d) =
    dep.kind=="FS" ? starts[dep.b]-dep.lag :
    dep.kind=="SS" ? starts[dep.b]-dep.lag+d : finishes[dep.b]-dep.lag
margin(s, dep) =
    dep.kind=="FS" ? s.es[dep.b]-s.ef[dep.a]-dep.lag :
    dep.kind=="SS" ? s.es[dep.b]-s.es[dep.a]-dep.lag : s.ef[dep.b]-s.ef[dep.a]-dep.lag
function schedulefields(s, name)
    [s.es[name], s.ef[name], s.ls[name], s.lf[name], s.tf[name], s.ff[name]]
end
critical(s) = Set(name for (name, value) in s.tf if value==0)
function compute_schedule(p, order, changed = nothing, replacement = 0)
    durations=Dict(name=>duration(task) for (name, task) in p.tasks)
    changed!==nothing && (durations[changed]=replacement)
    es=Dict{String,Int}()
    ef=Dict{String,Int}()
    ls=Dict{String,Int}()
    lf=Dict{String,Int}()
    for name in order
        es[name]=maximum(
            [
                p.tasks[name].notbefore;
                [startbound(dep, es, ef, durations[name]) for dep in preds(p, name)]
            ],
        )
        ef[name]=es[name]+durations[name]
    end
    projectlength=maximum(values(ef))
    for name in reverse(order)
        lf[name]=minimum(
            [projectlength; [finishbound(dep, ls, lf, durations[name]) for dep in succs(p, name)]],
        )
        ls[name]=lf[name]-durations[name]
    end
    tf=Dict(name=>ls[name]-es[name] for name in order)
    ff=Dict{String,Int}()
    result=Schedule(durations, es, ef, ls, lf, tf, ff, projectlength)
    for name in order
        ff[name]=minimum([projectlength-ef[name]; [margin(result, dep) for dep in succs(p, name)]])
    end
    result
end
function criticalpaths(p, s)
    selected=critical(s)
    links=Dict(
        name=>[dep.b for dep in succs(p, name) if dep.b in selected && margin(s, dep)==0] for
        name in selected
    )
    targets=Set([name for following in values(links) for name in following])
    result=Vector{String}[]
    function visit(path)
        following=links[last(path)]
        if isempty(following)
            push!(result, path)
        else
            for next in following
                visit([path; next])
            end
        end
    end
    for name in sort!(collect(setdiff(selected, targets)))
        visit([name])
    end
    result
end
function resourceusage(p, resource, starts, finishes)
    usage=Dict{Int,Int}()
    for (name, task) in p.tasks
        task.resource==resource || continue
        for day in starts[name]:(finishes[name]-1)
            usage[day]=get(usage, day, 0)+task.units
        end
    end
    usage
end
working(p, date) = dayofweek(date)<=5 && !(date in p.holidays)
function workingdates(p, count)
    result=Date[]
    date=p.start
    while length(result)<count
        working(p, date) && push!(result, date)
        date+=Day(1)
    end
    result
end
function workbetween(p, after, until)
    total=0
    date=after+Day(1)
    while date<=until
        total+=working(p, date)
        date+=Day(1)
    end
    total
end
function calendarreport(p, s)
    dates=workingdates(p, s.length)
    for name in sort!(tasknames(p); by = x->(s.es[x], x))
        println("$name $(datetext(dates[s.es[name]+1])) - $(datetext(dates[s.ef[name]]))")
    end
    spanstart=first(dates)
    finish=last(dates)
    println(
        "project $(datetext(spanstart)) - $(datetext(finish)), $(s.length) working days, $(Dates.value(finish-spanstart)+1) calendar days",
    )
    if p.deadline!==nothing
        if finish<=p.deadline
            println(
                "deadline $(datetext(p.deadline)) met, $(workbetween(p,finish,p.deadline)) working days to spare",
            )
        else
            println(
                "deadline $(datetext(p.deadline)) missed by $(workbetween(p,p.deadline,finish)) working days",
            )
        end
    end
    holidays=sort!([date for date in p.holidays if dayofweek(date)<=5 && spanstart<=date<=finish])
    println("holidays in span: ", isempty(holidays) ? "none" : join(datetext.(holidays), ", "))
end
function levelreport(p, s, limit)
    resources=sort!(unique([task.resource for task in values(p.tasks)]))
    capacity=Dict(r=>get(p.capacities, r, limit) for r in resources)
    for name in tasknames(p)
        task=p.tasks[name]
        check(
            task.units<=capacity[task.resource],
            "capacity $(capacity[task.resource]) too small for $name",
        )
    end
    starts=Dict{String,Int}()
    finishes=Dict{String,Int}()
    usage=Dict{Tuple{String,Int},Int}()
    order=String[]
    while length(order)<length(p.tasks)
        ready=[
            name for name in tasknames(p) if
            !haskey(starts, name) && all(dep->haskey(starts, dep.a), preds(p, name))
        ]
        name=ready[argmin([(s.ls[x], x) for x in ready])]
        task=p.tasks[name]
        d=duration(task)
        start=maximum(
            [task.notbefore; [startbound(dep, starts, finishes, d) for dep in preds(p, name)]],
        )
        while any(
            day->get(usage, (task.resource, day), 0)+task.units>capacity[task.resource],
            start:(start+d-1),
        )
            start+=1
        end
        starts[name]=start
        finishes[name]=start+d
        push!(order, name)
        for day in start:(start+d-1)
            key=(task.resource, day)
            usage[key]=get(usage, key, 0)+task.units
        end
    end
    println("level capacity $limit: duration $(s.length) -> $(maximum(values(finishes)))")
    for name in order
        println(
            "$name start $(starts[name]) finish $(finishes[name]) shift $(starts[name]-s.es[name])",
        )
    end
    for resource in resources
        before=maximum(values(resourceusage(p, resource, s.es, s.ef)); init = 0)
        after=maximum(values(resourceusage(p, resource, starts, finishes)); init = 0)
        println("resource $resource capacity $(capacity[resource]) peak $before -> $after")
    end
end
function crash!(p, order, budget)
    remaining=budget
    steps=0
    s=compute_schedule(p, order)
    initial=s.length
    reason=""
    while true
        candidates=[
            name for name in tasknames(p) if s.tf[name]==0 &&
                p.tasks[name].crashlimit!==nothing &&
                p.tasks[name].crashed<p.tasks[name].crashlimit &&
                compute_schedule(p, order, name, duration(p.tasks[name])-1).length<s.length
        ]
        if isempty(candidates)
            reason="no candidate"
            break
        end
        name=candidates[argmin([(p.tasks[x].crashcost, x) for x in candidates])]
        task=p.tasks[name]
        if task.crashcost>remaining
            reason="insufficient budget"
            break
        end
        old=duration(task)
        task.crashed+=1
        remaining-=task.crashcost
        steps+=1
        s=compute_schedule(p, order)
        println(
            "step $steps: $name $old -> $(duration(task)), cost $(task.crashcost), project $(s.length)",
        )
    end
    println(
        "crash done: $steps days, cost $(budget-remaining), project $initial -> $(s.length), budget left $remaining, $reason",
    )
end
function execute!(p, line)
    words=String.(split(line, ' '))
    command=words[1]
    args=words[2:end]
    if command=="TASK"
        name=args[1]
        check(!haskey(p.tasks, name), "task $name already exists")
        p.tasks[name]=WorkTask(parse(Int, args[2]), args[3], parse(Int, args[4]))
        println("task $name added")
    elseif command in ("DEP", "UNDEP")
        a, b=args[1:2]
        gettask(p, a)
        gettask(p, b)
        key=(a, b)
        if command=="DEP"
            check(a!=b, "self dependency $a")
            check(!haskey(p.links, key), "dependency $a -> $b already exists")
            dep=Dependency(a, b, args[3], parse(Int, args[4]))
            p.links[key]=dep
            println("dependency $a -> $b $(dep.kind)$(signedtext(dep.lag)) added")
        else
            check(haskey(p.links, key), "no dependency $a -> $b")
            delete!(p.links, key)
            println("dependency $a -> $b removed")
        end
    elseif command=="REMOVE"
        name=args[1]
        gettask(p, name)
        selected=[key for key in keys(p.links) if name in key]
        for key in selected
            delete!(p.links, key)
        end
        delete!(p.tasks, name)
        println("task $name removed with $(length(selected)) dependencies")
    elseif command in ("NOTBEFORE", "CRASHCOST", "UNCRASH", "PERT")
        name=args[1]
        task=gettask(p, name)
        if command=="NOTBEFORE"
            task.notbefore=parse(Int, args[2])
            println("notbefore $name $(args[2])")
        elseif command=="CRASHCOST"
            limit=parse(Int, args[2])
            check(limit<task.base, "crash limit too large for $name")
            check(limit>=task.crashed, "crash limit below used days for $name")
            task.crashlimit=limit
            task.crashcost=parse(Int, args[3])
            println("crash $name max $limit cost $(args[3])")
        elseif command=="UNCRASH"
            println("uncrash $name restored $(task.crashed) days")
            task.crashed=0
        else
            o, m, pe=parse.(Int, args[2:4])
            check(o<=m<=pe, "invalid estimate")
            task.estimate=(o, m, pe)
            println("pert $name expected $(decimals(o+4m+pe,6)) variance $(decimals((pe-o)^2,36))")
        end
    elseif command=="CAPACITY"
        p.capacities[args[1]]=parse(Int, args[2])
        println("capacity $(args[1]) $(args[2])")
    elseif command in ("START", "HOLIDAY", "DEADLINE")
        date=parsedate(args[1])
        if command=="START"
            p.start=date
        elseif command=="DEADLINE"
            p.deadline=date
        else
            check(!(date in p.holidays), "duplicate holiday $(args[1])")
            push!(p.holidays, date)
        end
        println(lowercase(command), " ", datetext(date))
    elseif command=="LIST"
        println(
            "tasks $(length(p.tasks)), dependencies $(length(p.links)), holidays $(length(p.holidays))",
        )
        for name in tasknames(p)
            task=p.tasks[name]
            previous=[dep.a for dep in preds(p, name)]
            println(
                "$name duration $(duration(task)) resource $(task.resource) units $(task.units) preds ",
                isempty(previous) ? "none" : join(previous, ' '),
            )
        end
    elseif command=="SHOW"
        name=args[1]
        task=gettask(p, name)
        println(
            "task $name duration $(duration(task)) resource $(task.resource) units $(task.units)",
            task.notbefore==0 ? "" : " notbefore $(task.notbefore)",
        )
        for (title, links) in (("preds", preds(p, name)), ("succs", succs(p, name)))
            entries=[
                "$(title=="preds" ? dep.a : dep.b) $(dep.kind)$(signedtext(dep.lag))" for
                dep in links
            ]
            println("$title: ", isempty(entries) ? "none" : join(entries, ", "))
        end
        println(
            "crash: ",
            task.crashlimit===nothing ? "none" :
            "max $(task.crashlimit) used $(task.crashed) cost $(task.crashcost)",
        )
        println("pert: ", task.estimate===nothing ? "none" : join(task.estimate, ' '))
        order=topo(p)
        if length(order)<length(p.tasks)
            println("schedule: unavailable")
        else
            s=compute_schedule(p, order)
            println(
                "schedule: ",
                join(
                    [
                        "$label $value" for (label, value) in
                        zip(["ES", "EF", "LS", "LF", "TF", "FF"], schedulefields(s, name))
                    ],
                    ' ',
                ),
                s.tf[name]==0 ? " critical" : "",
            )
        end
    elseif command=="IMPACT"
        name=args[1]
        gettask(p, name)
        seen=Set{String}()
        queue=[name]
        at=1
        while at<=length(queue)
            current=queue[at]
            at+=1
            for dep in succs(p, current)
                if !(dep.b in seen)
                    push!(seen, dep.b)
                    push!(queue, dep.b)
                end
            end
        end
        delete!(seen, name)
        println("impact $name: ", isempty(seen) ? "none" : namelist(seen))
    else
        order=analysisorder(p)
        if command=="CALENDAR"
            check(p.start!==nothing, "no start date")
        elseif command=="LOAD"
            check(any(t->t.resource==args[1], values(p.tasks)), "unknown resource $(args[1])")
        elseif command=="WHATIF"
            gettask(p, args[1])
        elseif command=="VARIANCE"
            check(p.baseline!==nothing, "no baseline")
        end
        s=compute_schedule(p, order)
        if command=="CPM"
            width=max(4, maximum(length, tasknames(p)))
            println(
                rpad("TASK", width),
                join(lpad.(["DUR", "ES", "EF", "LS", "LF", "TF", "FF"], 5)),
            )
            for name in tasknames(p)
                println(
                    rpad(name, width),
                    join(lpad.(string.([s.d[name]; schedulefields(s, name)]), 5)),
                    s.tf[name]==0 ? " *" : "",
                )
            end
            println("project duration $(s.length)")
        elseif command=="CRITICAL"
            paths=criticalpaths(p, s)
            println("critical paths: $(length(paths))")
            for path in paths
                println(join(path, " -> "))
            end
        elseif command=="SLACK"
            for f in sort!(unique(collect(values(s.tf))))
                println("float $f: ", namelist([name for name in tasknames(p) if s.tf[name]==f]))
            end
        elseif command=="DRAG"
            for name in sort!(collect(critical(s)))
                println("$name drag $(s.length-compute_schedule(p,order,name,0).length)")
            end
        elseif command=="STATS"
            n=length(p.tasks)
            c=length(critical(s))
            counts=[count(dep->dep.kind==kind, values(p.links)) for kind in ("FS", "SS", "FF")]
            println(
                "tasks $n, critical $c, dependencies $(length(p.links)) (FS $(counts[1]), SS $(counts[2]), FF $(counts[3]))",
            )
            resources=sort!(unique([t.resource for t in values(p.tasks)]))
            totals=[
                "$r $(sum(duration(t)*t.units for t in values(p.tasks) if t.resource==r))" for
                r in resources
            ]
            println("work ", join(totals, ", "))
            total=sum(values(s.tf))
            println(
                "float total $total, average $(decimals(total,n))\nduration $(s.length), critical share $(decimals(100c,n))%",
            )
        elseif command=="CALENDAR"
            calendarreport(p, s)
        elseif command=="GANTT"
            check(s.length<=60, "chart too wide ($(s.length) days)")
            width=maximum(length, tasknames(p))
            println(repeat(" ", width), " |", join(k%10 for k in 0:(s.length-1)), "|")
            for name in sort!(tasknames(p); by = x->(s.es[x], x))
                bar=join(
                    s.es[name]<=k<s.ef[name] ? (s.tf[name]==0 ? '=' : '-') :
                    s.ef[name]<=k<s.lf[name] ? '.' : ' ' for k in 0:(s.length-1)
                )
                println(rpad(name, width), " |", bar, "|")
            end
        elseif command=="LEVEL"
            levelreport(p, s, parse(Int, args[1]))
        elseif command=="LOAD"
            resource=args[1]
            usage=resourceusage(p, resource, s.es, s.ef)
            daily=[get(usage, k, 0) for k in 0:(s.length-1)]
            peak=maximum(daily)
            println("load $resource: ", join(daily, ' '))
            println("peak $peak on day $(findfirst(==(peak),daily)-1)")
            haskey(p.capacities, resource) && println(
                "capacity $(p.capacities[resource]) exceeded on $(count(>(p.capacities[resource]),daily)) days",
            )
        elseif command=="PERTSUM"
            for path in criticalpaths(p, s)
                mean=0
                variance=0
                for name in path
                    task=p.tasks[name]
                    o, m, pe=task.estimate===nothing ?
                             (duration(task), duration(task), duration(task)) : task.estimate
                    mean+=o+4m+pe
                    variance+=(pe-o)^2
                end
                println(
                    join(path, " -> "),
                    ": expected $(decimals(mean,6)) variance $(decimals(variance,36))",
                )
            end
        elseif command=="CRASH"
            crash!(p, order, parse(Int, args[1]))
        elseif command=="WHATIF"
            name=args[1]
            replacement=parse(Int, args[2])
            after=compute_schedule(p, order, name, replacement)
            println(
                "whatif $name $(duration(p.tasks[name])) -> $replacement: project $(s.length) -> $(after.length)",
            )
            for other in tasknames(p)
                changes=[
                    "$label $old->$new" for (label, old, new) in zip(
                        ("ES", "EF", "TF"),
                        (s.es[other], s.ef[other], s.tf[other]),
                        (after.es[other], after.ef[other], after.tf[other]),
                    ) if old!=new
                ]
                !isempty(changes) && println(other, " ", join(changes, ' '))
            end
            critical(s)!=critical(after) &&
                println("critical ", namelist(critical(s)), " -> ", namelist(critical(after)))
        elseif command=="BASELINE"
            p.baseline=s
            println("baseline saved: $(length(p.tasks)) tasks, duration $(s.length)")
        elseif command=="VARIANCE"
            before=p.baseline
            println(
                "variance: duration $(before.length) -> $(s.length) ($(signedtext(s.length-before.length)))",
            )
            printed=false
            for name in sort!(collect(union(Set(keys(before.es)), Set(tasknames(p)))))
                if !haskey(p.tasks, name)
                    println("$name removed")
                    printed=true
                elseif !haskey(before.es, name)
                    println("$name new")
                    printed=true
                elseif (before.es[name], before.ef[name])!=(s.es[name], s.ef[name])
                    println(
                        "$name start $(signedtext(s.es[name]-before.es[name])) finish $(signedtext(s.ef[name]-before.ef[name]))",
                    )
                    printed=true
                end
            end
            !printed && println("no task changes")
        end
    end
end
function main()
    project=Project()
    n=parse(Int, readline())
    for _ in 1:n
        line=readline()
        try
            execute!(project, line)
        catch e
            e isa CommandError || rethrow()
            println("error: $(e.message)")
        end
    end
end
main()
